We're a GAF Certified Plus contractor.

Only the top 5% of roofing contractors in North America qualify as GAF Certified Plus — a certification we renew every year. It means you get access to GAF's strongest manufacturer-backed warranties, including the Golden Pledge® Lifetime Roofing System.

To hold this certification, we're required to be:

  • Licensed & fully insured in Pennsylvania
  • Factory-trained on proper installation
  • Committed to ongoing education & standards
  • Backed by a proven track record of quality
  • Able to offer enhanced GAF warranty coverage
